name: openwa-core
description: Self-deployable WhatsApp Business API core for Cloudflare

CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Required. Generate a unique random value of at least 32 characters. OpenWA uses it only inside your Worker to encrypt Meta credentials stored in your D1 database.

CF_ACCESS_AUD.description: Required for dashboard login. The Cloudflare Access application audience (AUD) tag for this OpenWA Worker.

CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Required for dashboard login. Your Cloudflare Access team domain, for example team.cloudflareaccess.com.
